Anthropic reported cases in which a misconfigured third-party environment exposed real systems to agents pursuing simulated cyber tasks. posts.text: OpenAI's safety crisis keeps getting worse and the company keeps making it worse. OpenAI fired three safety researchers who helped investigate the Hugging Face hack.
